name: Content Telemetry & Performance Insights
description: Content-aware performance telemetry with editor-friendly insights and recommendations.
project_description: Content Telemetry & Performance Insights (CTPI) is a self-contained, privacy-safe performance monitoring module for Drupal 10 and 11. It instruments every front-end page request at the PHP level using a monotonic clock (hrtime), records render time, an estimated DB time, and cache-hit metadata, and writes an insert-only raw sample when the request is sampled. Drupal cron then rolls those raw samples up into bounded, idempotent hourly and daily aggregate tables (raw retention is 14 days). All data stays in the local database — there are no external service calls, no JavaScript trackers, and no PII collected. From the aggregates a deterministic, rule-based insight engine derives per-entity and site-wide health scores (0-100) and surfaces them through an admin UI (a dashboard, per-node/route/view/block reports and drilldowns) and a JSON insight API. All thresholds are configurable through a settings form, and everything the UI and API expose is gated by the 'view content telemetry' / 'administer content telemetry' permissions.
